description: Generate and score CRISPR guide-RNA candidates whose cut site falls in a target region, filtering by minimum score.

sequence.description: DNA sequence containing the target region.

region_end.description: 0-based inclusive end of the target region.

parameters.description: Optional guide-RNA design parameters (minGcContent, maxGcContent, minScore, avoidPolyT, checkSelfComplementarity, scoreGcContent (default true; false = CHOPCHOP's own default of no GC score term), ranking, maxSelfComplementaryStems, selfComplementarityBackboneRegions). maxSelfComplementaryStems (default null = no filter, CHOPCHOP filterSelfCompMax = -1) drops guides with more CHOPCHOP 4-bp self-complementary stems; selfComplementarityBackboneRegions (default null = guide-internal stems only) lists sgRNA scaffold regions, on the guide's strand, the stems may also pair against (CHOPCHOP --backbone). Defaults are used when null.

items.description: GuideRnaCandidate (same fields as evaluate_guide_rna; context30Mer / onTargetScore are set for 20-nt guides of the SpCas9 family with their flanks in the sequence).

position.description: 0-based forward-strand start of the protospacer (both strands).

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
Region start must be within the sequence
Region end must satisfy region_start <= region_end < sequence.Length
Invalid nucleotide '{char}' at position {i}. (the sequence must be A/C/G/T)
parameters invalid: GC window not 0 <= minGcContent <= maxGcContent <= 100, NaN minScore, negative maxSelfComplementaryStems, undefined ranking, invalid backbone region, or all-zero parameters.

examples.name: Single SpCas9 guide with NGG PAM
